subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should ClawHub add automatic README-based changelog previews to the plugin release publish flow, or keep package release changelogs manual-only for now?
rationale: Current main is manual-only while this PR adds a new public action and auto-fill behavior; that user-facing direction has not been explicitly accepted by a maintainer in the PR discussion.

options.title: Accept auto-preview after prompt fix
options.body: Land the feature direction once the package prompt labels are repaired and ordinary review gates are clear.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual-only
options.body: Close or narrow this PR if maintainers do not want generated package release notes in the current publish route.

options.title: Defer to a design follow-up
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a narrower maintainer-approved design before adding generated package changelogs.

recommendation.title: Accept auto-preview after prompt fix
recommendation.body: Land the feature direction once the package prompt labels are repaired and ordinary review gates are clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the best available routing owner from the current publish/package history and live review request.
